insert into raw_events (external_id, payload, event_source, processing_status, error_message, manual_review_reason)
values (COALESCE(
    NULLIF('{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.external_id }}', ''),
    'missing_external_id_' || EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::text
),
    '{{ JSON.stringify($('When clicking ‘Execute workflow’').item.json) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.event_source }}',
  'manual_review',
  'Validation failed: {{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.validation_errors.join(", ") }}',
  'Invalid support ticket payload: {{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.validation_errors.join(", ") }}'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE
SET processing_status = 'manual_review',
    error_message = EXCLUDED.error_message,
    manual_review_reason = EXCLUDED.manual_review_reason,
    updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING internal_id, external_id;

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    workflow_name,
    event_id,
    step_name,
    status,
    wf_message
)
VALUES (
   '{{ $workflow.name }}',
    {{ $json.internal_id }},
    'validation_failed',
    'failed',
    'Payload validation failed: {{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.validation_errors.join(", ") }}'
);
select internal_id, external_id from raw_events where external_id = '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').item.json.external_id }}';

insert into workflow_logs (workflow_name, event_id, step_name, status, wf_message) values ('{{ $workflow.name }}', {{ $json.internal_id }}, 'duplicate_event_check', 'skipped','Event already exists. Processing stopped.')

insert into workflow_logs 
	(
    workflow_name,
	event_id,
	step_name,

	) 
values 
	(

	'success',
    'Raw event inserted successfully.'
	)
;

select * 
from raw_events 
where external_id = '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').item.json.external_id}}';

SELECT
    {{ $json.internal_id }} AS event_id,
    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.external_id }}' AS external_id,
    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.clickup_task_id }}' AS clickup_task_id,
    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.clickup_task_url }}' AS clickup_task_url,

    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.requester_name }}' AS requester_name,
    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.requester_email }}' AS requester_email,
    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.requester_company }}' AS requester_company,

    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.subject }}' AS subject,
    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.message }}' AS message,
    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.product }}' AS product,

    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.category }}' AS category,
    '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.priority }}' AS priority,

    sp.internal_id AS sla_policy_id,
    sp.response_time_minutes,
    NOW() + (sp.response_time_minutes || ' minutes')::interval AS sla_due_at
FROM sla_policies sp
WHERE sp.priority = '{{ $('Normalize ClickUp Ticket').first().json.priority }}';

SELECT
    {{ $json.event_id }} AS event_id,
    '{{ $json.external_id }}' AS external_id,
    '{{ $json.clickup_task_id }}' AS clickup_task_id,
    '{{ $json.clickup_task_url }}' AS clickup_task_url,

    '{{ $json.requester_name }}' AS requester_name,
    '{{ $json.requester_email }}' AS requester_email,
    '{{ $json.requester_company }}' AS requester_company,

    '{{ $json.subject }}' AS subject,
    '{{ $json.message }}' AS message,
    '{{ $json.product }}' AS product,

    '{{ $json.category }}' AS category,
    '{{ $json.priority }}' AS priority,

    {{ $json.sla_policy_id }} AS sla_policy_id,
    '{{ $json.sla_due_at }}'::timestamp AS sla_due_at,

    CASE
        WHEN '{{ $json.category }}' = 'billing' THEN 'Billing'
        WHEN '{{ $json.category }}' = 'technical' THEN 'Technical'
        WHEN '{{ $json.category }}' = 'account' THEN 'Customer Success'
        WHEN '{{ $json.category }}' = 'feature_request' THEN 'Customer Success'
        ELSE 'Operations'
    END AS assigned_team,

    tm.member_email AS assigned_to
FROM team_members tm
WHERE tm.team_name =
    CASE
        WHEN '{{ $json.category }}' = 'billing' THEN 'Billing'
        WHEN '{{ $json.category }}' = 'technical' THEN 'Technical'
        WHEN '{{ $json.category }}' = 'account' THEN 'Customer Success'
        WHEN '{{ $json.category }}' = 'feature_request' THEN 'Customer Success'
        ELSE 'Operations'
    END
  AND tm.is_active = true
ORDER BY tm.internal_id
LIMIT 1;

WITH inserted_ticket AS (
    INSERT INTO tickets (
        external_id,
        event_id,
        requester_name,
        requester_email,
        requester_company,
        subject,
        message,
        product,
        category,
        priority,
        status,
        assigned_team,
        assigned_to,
        sla_policy_id,
        sla_due_at
    )
    VALUES (
        '{{ $json.external_id }}',
        {{ $json.event_id }},
        '{{ $json.requester_name }}',
        '{{ $json.requester_email }}',
        '{{ $json.requester_company }}',
        '{{ $json.subject }}',
        '{{ $json.message }}',
        '{{ $json.product }}',
        '{{ $json.category }}',
        '{{ $json.priority }}',
        'open',
        '{{ $json.assigned_team }}',
        '{{ $json.assigned_to }}',
        {{ $json.sla_policy_id }},
        '{{ $json.sla_due_at }}'::timestamp
    )
    ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE
    SET updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

ticket_log AS (
    INSERT INTO ticket_logs (
        ticket_id,
        action,
        actor_type,
        message
    )
    SELECT
        internal_id,
        'ticket_created',
        'system',
        'Ticket created from ClickUp form and triaged automatically.'
    FROM inserted_ticket
    RETURNING ticket_id
),

workflow_log AS (
    INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
        workflow_name,
        event_id,
        ticket_id,
        step_name,
        status,
        wf_message
    )
    SELECT
        '{{ $workflow.name }}',
        event_id,
        internal_id,
        'ticket_created',
        'success',
        'Support ticket created and triaged successfully.'
    FROM inserted_ticket
    RETURNING ticket_id
)

SELECT
    internal_id AS ticket_id,
    event_id,
    external_id,
    requester_name,
    requester_email,
    requester_company,
    subject,
    message,
    product,
    category,
    priority,
    status,
    assigned_team,
    assigned_to,
    sla_policy_id,
    sla_due_at
FROM inserted_ticket;

UPDATE raw_events
SET processing_status = 'completed',
    processed_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW(),
    error_message = NULL
WHERE internal_id = {{ $('Insert ticket').item.json.event_id }};

VALUES (

INSERT INTO workflow_logs (
    workflow_name,

    step_name,

VALUES (
    '{{ $workflow.name }}',
    {{ $('Insert ticket').item.json.event_id }},
    {{ $('Insert ticket').item.json.ticket_id }},

SELECT
    {{ $('Insert ticket').item.json.ticket_id }} AS ticket_id,
    {{ $('Insert ticket').item.json.event_id }} AS event_id,
    '{{ $('Insert ticket').item.json.external_id }}' AS external_id,
